name: Hide Faces by Angle
description: Hides faces whose normal points farther from an axis than an angle, or the opposite with Invert. Mostly-masked faces can keep their visibility. Shows the result before you accept it.

params.label: Angle (degrees)
params.help: Hide a face when the angle between its normal and the axis is greater than this. 90 hides faces that face away from the axis.

params.label: Invert
params.help: Hide the faces that would have stayed visible.

params.label: Keep masked faces
params.help: A face whose vertices are mostly masked keeps the visibility it already has.

params.text: Hidden faces stay in the piece. Show them again from the face-group or visibility tools, or run this with a wider angle.
